∠D =180 ̊ - 60 ̊ = 120 ̊

40 ̊ + 120 ̊ + ∠BCD = 180 ̊,

questions.q_en: In a ABC, points P, Q and R are taken on AB, BC and CA, respectively, such that BQ = PQ and QC = QR. If BAC = 75°. What is the measure of PQR [in degrees]?
questions.q_hi: ABC में, AB, BC और CA पर क्रमशः P, Q और R बिंदु इस प्रकार लिए गए हैं कि BQ = PQ और QC = QR है। यदि BAC = 75° है। PQR का माप [डिग्री में] क्या है?
options_en: 40
30
50
75
questions.solution_en:
Given the, ∠A = 75 ̊
BQ = PQ & QC = QR
Let ∠PQR = x ̊
∠ABC = b ̊ & ∠ACB = c
Then in ∠ABC
75 + b + c = 180 ̊
b + c = 105 ̊
Now; in ∠BPQ,
b + b + ∠BQP = 180 ̊
∠BQP = 180 ̊ - 2b

Similarly, ∠CQR =180 - 2C

adding both;
∠BQP + ∠CQR = 360 ̊ - 2[b + c] = 360 ̊ - 2[105 ̊] = 150 ̊

Now,
∠BQP + ∠CQR + x ̊=180 ̊ [Same line]
∴150 ̊ + x =180 ̊ => x = 30 ̊

Short: Remember that
∠PQR + 2∠BAC = 180 ̊
∴∠PQR + 2 × 75 ̊= 180 ̊
∠PQR = 30 ̊

BQ = PQ और QC = QR
मान लीजिए ∠PQR = x ̊
∠ABC = b ̊ और ∠ACB = c
फिर ∠ABC में
75 ̊ + b + c = 180 ̊

b + c = 105 ̊
अब; ∠BPQ में,
b + b + ∠BQP = 180 ̊
∠BQP = 180 ̊ - 2b

इसी प्रकार, ∠CQR =180 ̊- 2C

दोनों को जोड़ने पर;
∠BQP + ∠CQR = 360 ̊ - 2[b + c] =360 ̊ - 2[105 ̊] = 150 ̊

अब,
∠BQP + ∠CQR + x ̊=180 ̊ [समान रेखा]
∴150 ̊ + x =180 ̊ => x = 30 ̊

संक्षिप्त: याद रखें कि
∠PQR + 2∠BAC = 180 ̊
∴∠PQR + 2 × 75 ̊= 180 ̊
∠PQR = 30 ̊

questions.q_en: In the given triangle, CD is the bisector of BCA. CD = DA. If BDC = 76°, what is the measure of CBD (in degree)?

76°
80°
66°
questions.solution_en:
Given that CD in angle bisector,

Let ∠CAD = x ̊, then
∠CAD = ∠DCA = x ̊ [∵CD = DA]
& ∠BCD =∠DCA =x ̊[angle bisector]
∠BDC = x + x =2x ̊[Exterior angle]
∴2x = 76 ̊
x = 38 ̊
So, in △BCD
3x + ∠CBD = 180 ̊
3 × 38 + ∠CBD = 180 ̊
∠CBD = 180 114 = 66 ̊
